description: END a LinkedIn boost: LinkedIn DELETES the boost campaign (it is not a pause; delivery stops). Name the boosted post (its campaign is looked up from LinkedIn) or pass campaign + account URNs from linkedin_boost_status. Without confirm it says what would be deleted; confirm:true does it and reads the post’s status back.

confirm.description: true to delete the boost campaign

organization.description: Company Page id or name, for a Page post

post.description: the boosted post URN or link

name: end_linkedin_boost
title: End a LinkedIn boost
